verse.text: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

reflection.scripture: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.
reflection.observation: Walking in the light isn't a solo journey — it's a shared path. John connects our vertical relationship with God (walking in His light) to our horizontal relationships with each other (fellowship). The same light that reveals also purifies. There's no hidden corner where sin can fester when we live openly before God and in community with believers.
reflection.application: Today, I'll examine one area where I've been hiding in shadows rather than bringing it into the light. I'll also reach out to someone in my faith community — not for perfection, but for honest fellowship.
reflection.prayer: Lord, thank You that Your light doesn't condemn but cleanses. Help me walk openly before You today. Give me courage to live transparently with others and receive the purification only Your Son's blood provides. In Jesus' name, amen.
